title: Project activity overview
responsibility: Presents recorded repository activity alongside available live agent and worktree observations.

inputs.name: ProjectActivity.activity
inputs.description: Required recorded activity, including repository identity, branch/head, work and loops. Its kind controls whether registry information is described as recorded.

inputs.name: ProjectActivity.live
inputs.description: Required live observations or null. Supplies agent and worktree state when available.

inputs.name: ProjectActivity.base
inputs.description: Required explorer prefix used for commit links. A commit uses the current branch when it belongs there, otherwise a listed matching branch.

inputs.name: ProjectActivity.reading
inputs.type: { now: number; failed: boolean; refresh: () => void }
inputs.description: Optional live-reading state, supplying the current time, failed-read flag and refresh callback to the live views.

outputs.name: ProjectActivity
outputs.description: Repository identity and commit navigation, agent observations, worktrees, recorded work and loops. Missing live data remains distinguishable from observations. This component renders supplied data and does not fetch it.
